description: This file defines a Flutter widget for an Analytics Screen, providing a dashboard with KPIs, filters, export options, and quiz performance details within a learning app.

classes.name: AnalyticsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays quiz analytics, including KPIs, filters, export options, and per-quiz stats.

classes.name: KpiCard
classes.description: A widget representing a KPI tile with a title, value, icon, and accent color.

classes.name: SparkBar
classes.description: A small, animated bar representing a percentage value, used for visualizing quiz scores.

methods.name: _filterBar
methods.description: Builds the filter UI for category, date range, and export options.

methods.name: _isSameRange
methods.description: Checks if the current filter matches a preset range of a specified number of days.

methods.name: _isThisWeek
methods.description: Checks if the current filter matches this week's date range.

methods.name: _isThisMonth
methods.description: Checks if the current filter matches this month's date range.

methods.name: _isAll
methods.description: Checks if the current filter covers the maximum time range (last 5 years).

methods.name: _presetChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for a preset date range.

methods.name: _weekChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for 'This week' preset.

methods.name: _monthChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for 'This month' preset.

methods.name: _allChip
methods.description: Creates a ChoiceChip for 'All time' preset.

methods.name: _resetChip
methods.description: Creates a chip to reset filters to default.

methods.name: _rangeLabel
methods.description: Formats a date range label for display.

methods.name: _onExportPressed
methods.description: Handles exporting analytics data to CSV or JSON files based on current filters.

methods.name: _showSnack
methods.description: Displays a brief SnackBar message to the user.

methods.name: _quizStatTile
methods.description: Builds a widget showing stats for a single quiz, including scores and attempts.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Creates a styled label widget used within quiz stat tiles.

methods.name: _emptyStateFiltered
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no data available for current filters and provides a reset button.
